description: Mid-size electric utility. Interstate transmission developer and Open Access Transmission Tariff (OATT) filer under FERC jurisdiction. This is the company context the judge maps regulatory changes onto: the obligations register, projects, and internal documents.

obligations.title: Applicant Code of Conduct
obligations.description: Maintain and follow the Applicant Code of Conduct governing communications between transmission applicants and affected landowners during pre-filing and siting.

obligations.title: Pre-filing environmental report (Exhibit H)
obligations.description: Prepare and file the Exhibit H system analysis data and environmental report contents required for a transmission siting application.

obligations.title: Pre-filing consultation and stakeholder outreach
obligations.description: Conduct and document pre-filing consultation, including the stakeholder participation plan and outreach to affected parties before commencing the formal filing.

obligations.title: Transmission siting compliance
obligations.description: Meet the filing obligations for interstate electric transmission facilities, including stakeholder participation plan contents and any tribal engagement requirements, for siting proceedings.

obligations.title: Transmission line ratings (ambient-adjusted ratings)
obligations.description: Implement and maintain ambient-adjusted transmission line ratings in the Open Access Transmission Tariff as required for transmission service.

obligations.title: Wholesale rate (OATT) filings
obligations.description: File and maintain the wholesale Open Access Transmission Tariff and associated rate schedules.

obligations.title: NERC CIP cybersecurity incident reporting
obligations.description: Report cybersecurity incidents affecting bulk electric system cyber assets under the mandatory reliability standards.

obligations.title: Standards of conduct (transmission/marketing separation)
obligations.description: Maintain functional separation between transmission and marketing functions under the Standards of Conduct.

obligations.title: Qualifying facility self-certification
obligations.description: Maintain qualifying facility (QF) status self-certifications for company-affiliated small power production facilities.

obligations.title: Merger and acquisition authorization
obligations.description: Obtain Section 203 authorization for dispositions of jurisdictional facilities and changes in control.

obligations.title: Interlocking directorate reporting
obligations.description: File interlocking directorate authorizations for officers and directors holding positions across jurisdictional entities.

obligations.title: EQR (Electric Quarterly Report) filing
obligations.description: File the Electric Quarterly Report of wholesale power and transmission transactions.

obligations.title: FERC Form 1 annual report
obligations.description: File the FERC Form 1 annual report of major electric utilities.

projects.name: Cascade Crossing
projects.description: Interstate transmission line siting proceeding; in pre-filing.

projects.name: Coastal Uprate
projects.description: Existing transmission line uprate under OATT.
